svg.title: Robust Perception and Autonomous Navigation: research overview
svg.desc: Robust Perception & Navigation: Perception that holds up, decisions that stay safe. Sub-areas: Robust perception (Vision that keeps working in poor light, low texture and underwater.); Multisensor fusion (Cameras, LiDAR, IMU and wheel odometry combined into one estimate.); Swarm robotics (Teams of drones and robots that explore and navigate together.); Social navigation (Moving safely and naturally around people.). Open questions: Failing gracefully when sensors degrade; Planning with perception uncertainty, not around it; Navigation that people find predictable.
